title: Disbursement of Approved Paper Claims — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit an approved paper-claim reimbursement of at least the network's minimum payment is paid in full, once, by one of the network's payment methods: direct deposit when the member has banking details on file and the network allows it, otherwise a check mailed to the address on file.

## Conditions of payment

1. A reimbursement may be paid only after its submission has been approved, and only once; both are read from the approvals and payments recorded against that submission.
2. The payment amount equals the approved reimbursement amount. Partial payments are not made.
3. An approved reimbursement below the minimum payment is paid nothing.

## Payment method

| Network offers direct deposit | Banking details on file | Method |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Direct deposit |
| Yes | No | Check mailed to the address on file |
| No | Either | Check mailed to the address on file |

## Cases (hypothetical amounts)

- An approval of 42.18 USD on a network whose minimum payment is 1.00 USD is paid as 42.18 USD in one payment, never in parts.
- An approval of 0.64 USD on the same network is below the minimum payment, so no payment is issued.
- A submission that is still awaiting its decision cannot be paid.
- A submission whose reimbursement has already been paid is not paid a second time.
